# cloudflare_zero_trust_cws_basic_auth_credential (Resource)



## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "cloudflare_zero_trust_cws_basic_auth_credential" "example_zero_trust_cws_basic_auth_credential" {
  account_id = "xxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxx"
  username = "x"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `account_id` (String) Cloudflare account ID (32-character hexadecimal string)
- `username` (String) Login presented by the client. Printable ASCII only, excluding space and colon.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String)
- `id` (String) Server-assigned UUID
- `updated_at` (String)

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

```shell
$ terraform import cloudflare_zero_trust_cws_basic_auth_credential.example '<account_id>/<credential_id>'
```
